core_obligations: (1) implies (2): a dimension function on the space restricts to one on the groupoid of a finite flat presentation; the quotient identification transfers it.
(2) implies (1): the dimension function on the groupoid quotient descends to the space; the two defining axioms descend along the finite flat presentation.
proof_roadmap: Restrict along the presentation; descend along the quotient.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction transfer of a structure; the descent of the axioms is the substance.
